## Aspose.Font FOSS for Python 26.9.2

This release publishes the clean public source package for Aspose.Font FOSS for Python.

### Included

- Pure-Python library source code
- Public test suite and sample font data
- README assets and packaging metadata

### Installation from GitHub

```bash
pip install "aspose-font @ git+https://github.com/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python.git@26.9.2"
```

PyPI distribution will be added in a later release.

Clean public source mirror for `2026.5.1`.

- Source: GitLab clean mirror deployment
- Target branch: `main`

This release contains the public library source tree and generated README assets.
